description: List the caller's verified domains with package counts, or the packages Shield has observed on one domain. With includeThreats, one domain's packages come back annotated with malware verdicts and CVEs, ranked by the domain's own traffic. Requires Shield login.

days.description: Lookback window for threats mode. Default 30; 0 = all-time.

domain.description: One verified domain. Omit to list domains with package counts.

includeThreats.description: Annotate one domain's packages with verdicts and CVEs. Requires domain.

name: shield_domain_packages
title: Shield-observed packages on your domains
